title: THE BLOCK: Solana's new v1 transaction format is now live on mainnet, supporting transactions of up to 4,096 bytes, compared with the 1,232-byte limit for legacy and v0 transactions. The upgrade enables larger workloads,
snippet: THE BLOCK: Solana's new v1 transaction format is now live on mainnet, supporting transactions of up to 4,096 bytes, compared with the 1,232-byte limit for legacy and v0 transactions. The upgrade enables larger workloads, including ZK proofs and large multisigs, to fit within a single transaction.
